headline: YouTube builds custom feeds with AI, adds GIF comments
summary: The platform is rolling out AI-powered tools to help users curate their content and creators manage their channels, alongside new comment and shopping features.
details: YouTube is introducing custom feeds that users can create using conversational AI prompts. These feeds can be tailored to specific interests, moods, or to discover new creators within a niche, offering more control over the algorithm.

Creators can now organize Shorts into episodic series with custom thumbnails and sequential playback, enhancing the 'shows' feature for content like microdramas and making it easier for viewers to follow along.
Users will soon be able to leave GIF comments under videos, with a searchable library available globally on mobile this fall. TV app users can also post comments using voice-to-text functionality.

The 'Ask YouTube' feature is expanding to include more shopping capabilities, providing video recommendations and product comparison tables for items featured in videos, even if not explicitly mentioned by the creator.
YouTube Music is enhancing its AI tools with 'Ask Music' for artist information and 'Podcast Lineup' for show discovery, offering weekly previews to Premium subscribers.
The platform is also extending its Coachella streaming rights through 2030 and piloting a Live auto-dubbing tool for real-time translation in early 2027.
